title: Canonical cone on sections of affine formal quotients
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, J an ideal sheaf on Spec A, and N a module over B=AdicCompletion I A. Define a cone with vertex N restricted to A on the sections of formalCompletionSystem J (tilde N). Its projection at op n is the tilde/global-sections unit followed by global sections of formalModuleQuotientπ J (n+1) (tilde N). Transition compatibility follows from the quotient factorization identity.

proof.text: Construct the cone with the stated maps. For every transition, the cokernel defining the reduction has composite with its source quotient projection equal to the target quotient projection. Applying global sections and composing the unit proves the cone naturality equation.
